There's reports of zombie activity nearby.
Secure the area and keep an eye out. We have teams that are pushing them in our direction.
We've got Speedy zombies coming in!
It's nice to have some normal missions for a change. It's been awhile after everything that's happened.
Well, as normal as it can be.
Something's not right about the hoard. It looks like they've… mutated?
I'm contacting V for more insight. Be careful.
I don't like the look of that Boss. These things are strong!
I don't want any surprises. Make sure we can see any Hidden enemies that could get behind us.
Commander? It's V. I'll be overviewing your mission while Dispatcher is… away.
From what I can tell, Patient Zero's virus has started to evolve. It'll definitely need to be studied, so drag me back a corpse or two?
That looks like a Bolt zombie! Medic has been dying to cut into one of those!
Hmm… Maybe when she's done, I could use a hydraulic press and shove it into a battery.
There is something seriously wrong with the both of you!
Watch out! There's a mutated ghoul somewhere in the hoard. It looks like it's Hidden, so be careful.
I see a Living Experiment up ahead!
Concentrate your fire on that Speedy Boss! Don't let it get past us!
Hey Commander, I've made some discoveries going through the files.
It seems a medical specialist named Dr. Herrschaft used to work at a local town hospital, but was fired for experimenting on his patients.
According to the documents gathered so far, he spent time as a virologist who worked on viruses that were thousands of years old. That's insane.
Here's some more. It was a hunch, but Dr. Herrschaft had created the foundation for the healing tech we use because of his cell replication studies.

That healing technology is based off of a virus that forces damaged cells to repair and multiply, and that was the center of his work. Instead of losing all that research, TDS took possession of it and had Medic create a healing particle beam. Woah.
From my guess, Dr. Herrschaft lost his license and went to his hometown to work on the virus once more. This date is right around the time the zombie outbreak happened!

Wait... What if Dr. Herrschaft is Patient Zero? I mean, it wasn't until after the zombies started taking over the cities, and if he were to get infected it wouldn't surprise me he would be first in contact.
I'll contact Headquarters. This discovery needs to be reported ASAP. Keep everything that was found between you and I.
We've got eyes on Patient Zero. Make sure all units are ready!
When we get back to base, I'm going to have a long talk with Medic.
There's Patient Zero, give it everything we've got!
